newGame.title: New game
newGame.mixedVariant: {scenario} (choose A or B for each villain)
newGame.magogRandomGenre: One of these six genre sets is chosen at random when the game starts.
newGame.magogCustomGenre: Your selected modular set replaces the random genre set.
newGame.noMatchingSets: No sets match. Try another search or release.
newGame.hoodModularsHint: {count}/7 modular sets selected. Choose exactly seven to continue.
newGame.noRecommendedModulars: No specific modular sets are recommended for this scenario. Choose the sets you want to use.
newGame.hoodDifficultyGuide: The Hood: modular set difficulty guide
newGame.hoodDifficultyBands: The insert ranks this pack's sets from easiest (1) to hardest (9). For a lower-difficulty game, choose ranks 1–7; for moderate difficulty, 2–8; for higher difficulty, 3–9.

modularRules.mojo: You can swap the recommended modular sets for other genre sets. Longshot is optional and does not count toward the genre set total.
modularRules.core: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically.
modularRules.gob: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically.
modularRules.twc: The Wrecking Crew does not use modular sets.
modularRules.trors: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically.
modularRules.toafk: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically. Choose one modular set: Temporal (difficulty 4), Master of Time (difficulty 6), or Anachronauts (difficulty 8), or a set from another release.
modularRules.gmw: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically.
modularRules.mts: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically.
modularRules.hood: Choose seven modular sets. One is added to the encounter deck at random; the others are set aside and can enter play later.
modularRules.other: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically. If no sets are recommended, choose the sets you want to use.
modularRules.mut_gen: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically.
modularRules.sm: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically.
modularRules.next_evol: You can swap the recommended modular sets for others. Required sets are included automatically.
modularRules.aoa: Use the required encounter sets and the recommended modular sets shown, or replace modular sets to customize the scenario. Standard III may replace the core Standard set.
modularRules.tt: Each scenario uses one modular encounter set. Trickster Magic is recommended. God of Lies uses Single Group Mode.

newGame.modularsHint: The scenario's recommended set is chosen to begin with; add or swap others to vary it.
newGame.difficultyHint: Expert adds the expert encounter set and starts the villain a stage later.
newGame.noDecks: You have no decks yet. Load one from a MarvelCDB link, or import it on the Decks page.
newGame.allowSpectatorsHint: List this game on the Watch page so anyone can watch it. Spectators see the table but cannot take any actions.
newGame.campaignModeHint: The expert campaign keeps each hero's damage from one scenario to the next, and heals it with obligations.
newGame.scenarioDifficultyHint: Each scenario's difficulty: expert adds the expert set and starts the villain a stage later.
newGame.playersHint: In the lobby each seat takes a deck: take them all yourself, or send friends the link to take theirs.
newGame.campaignPlayersHint: In the lobby each seat takes a deck, its hero kept for the whole campaign: take them all yourself, or send friends the link to take theirs.

version.title: Version
version.hint: Standard puts each villain's version A into play, expert its version B. Extreme starts each version A with its version B under it, entering play when it is defeated. Or the players choose version A or B for each villain.
